description: Update an external plugin source of a plugin to its new version. Without `decisions` (safe mode) it checks and applies: every new item is added, nothing is replaced or removed, the rules are kept and the source moves to the new version; an up-to-date source changes nothing. `decisions` is the update preview's shape: `previewId`, `sourceFingerprint`, `fingerprint`, per kind (`skills`, `agents`, `mcpServers`) the lists `add`, `replace`, `remove` (delete from the plugin) and `keep` (keep as the plugin's own) of `{name}` items, `confirmReplace` (required to replace or remove) and `rules` keep | append | replace. A `library_merge_stale` error means the plugin changed since the preview: repeat it. `plugin` is required. When `plugin` is the installed plugin, it is then regenerated locally, like `athenode init` without confirmation (the result adds `install` and `regeneration`); if that fails, the backend change is still saved and the tool returns an error. Any other plugin is changed on the server only.

decisions.description: Decisions: {previewId, sourceFingerprint, fingerprint, confirmReplace?, skills?, agents?, mcpServers?, rules?}, each kind as {add?, replace?, remove?, keep?} (CLI: --decisions). Safe mode if omitted.

path.description: Folder of the new version of an uploaded external plugin, resolved against the project root (CLI: --path); an external plugin imported from a URL is checked by its URL.

plugin.description: Name of the plugin, or its id with pluginById (CLI: --plugin). Required.

pluginById.description: `plugin` is a plugin id, not a name (CLI: --plugin-by-id).

pluginSource.description: The external plugin source: its id, or its name when the plugin has one source of that name (see plugins_external_sources).

name: plugins_external_update
title: Update external plugin
